BiblicalUsage: To say, in the Aramaic of Daniel, and the whole book speaks in it. Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack, O king, live for ever: tell thy servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation. And the king answered and said to Daniel, Of a truth it is, that your God is a God of gods, and a Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing thou couldest reveal this secret.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for saying carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the two speeches, that the Chaldeans spoke to buy time and the king spoke to confess that Daniel's God reveals secrets.
